content: .{@-र्दः@} .²1 a companion, parasite, one who assists the hero of a drama in great undertakings, {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} in securing his mistress; <ls>Dk. 2. 2</ls>; so पीठमर्दिका ‘a lady who assists the heroine in securing her lover’; उपस्थिता पीठमर्दिकां पण्डितकौशिकीं पुरस्कृत्य देवी <ls>M. 1. 13/14</ls>. .²2 a dancing master who instructs courtezans in the art of dancing.
